title: A Family Reception for Fallen Members
description: Airmen assigned to the 106th Rescue Wing, New York Air National Guard, held a family reception for Maj. Christopher T. Zanetis, HH-60 rescue pilot, Master Sgt. Christopher J. Raguso, HH-60 rescue pilot and Tech. Sgt. Dashan J. Briggs, special missions aviation specialist, assigned to the 106RQW, at F. S. Gabreski Air National Guard Base, Westhampton Beach, N.Y., March 27, 2018. The three Airmen were killed when the HH-60G Pave Hawk helicopter they were flying in crashed near the city of Al-Qa’im, Iraq. (U.S. Air National Gurad video by Airman Sean B. Madden)
